name: Drahi-X
description: Provides nanogrid-level load time series data and a standardized evaluation framework to benchmark forecasting models for micro/nanogrids.
evaluation_method: MAE / RMSE (mean absolute error / root mean squared error)
reputation: A niche, recently published dataset and standardized evaluation for micro/nanogrid forecasting with limited adoption outside power-systems research.
notes: Non-LLM time-series benchmark; performance depends heavily on forecasting horizon and preprocessing; may be small/site-specific and thus have limited generalization.
